title: Measure and reduce repeated queue-hash work on warm snapshot-cache hits
outcome: Warm snapshot-cache validation has a measured cost breakdown and avoids unnecessary repeated queue-hash construction under StateInner where that can be done without weakening exhaustive projection validation or exact-cut ordering.
acceptance: Record a controlled comparison of warm cache-hit validation and fresh summary projection at a documented session count and queued-prompt distribution, separating hash/projection work from lock waiting; fixture timings are not live-host proof.

Any optimization preserves exhaustive validation against unstamped session mutations, queue and pause changes, body-sequence/instance epochs, exact immutable cuts and publication ordering, with focused regressions on the final source.
Record the required review and gate evidence for any source change; retain the existing validator if the proposed optimization cannot preserve its correctness contract.
